scope: NBHL ball hockey only. Previously reviewed development and regression references are reused and correlated; these are diagnostics, not independent accuracy estimates.

families.anchor: One-to-one SAM3 mask-box / fixed YOLO player detection matching; IoU >=0.3 or0.5 and bidirectional competitor margin >=0.05. Output current detection boxes only.
families.appearance_split: Split anchored SAM3 tracks after three consecutive uncluttered detections whose OSNet cosine to running reference is below0.45,0.60,or0.75; split at scene boundaries and gaps over15frames. Labels never enter inference.
families.reconnection: Existing global forward path assignment; OSNet mean cosine0.75,0.85,or0.92, gap<=300frames, support>=10, existing camera-compensated motion gate. Also test frozen Qwen2B joint embedding blend on newly prepared fragments.
families.consensus: Add SAM3 agreement across endpoint observations as bounded evidence to SAM2 fragment links, or require it. Compare with the same frozen OSNet/Qwen features and observations. Apply the five declared policies to OSNet-only and the frozen OSNet/Qwen2B-joint blend, using the original label-free candidate shortlist. This extension was recorded before any new regression scores.
families.native_settings: Development-only ablations: association IoU0.3, reconditioning every4frames, reconditioning disabled, short keep-alive8frames. Freeze a winning setting before regression.
families.long: Continuous five-minute native SAM3 and overlapping bounded windows on longer cached NBHL segments. No full-game identity claim without reference. Retain gaps.

selection: For each family maximize development correct-10*wrong, then matched observations, then fewer uncertain joins, then fewer changes from baseline. Evaluate frozen choices once on reused regression; report all failures and all development settings. No manual per-player corrections.
metrics: Sparse reviewed endpoint pairs at box IoU>=0.5, observation coverage, wrong and uncertain joins, fragmentation, wall time, runtime failures. No TOI, miles, HOTA or IDF1 claim from sparse pairs.
training: Inference and association experiments initially; any weight training requires a separately recorded training protocol and ball-hockey-only data.
